findings.statement: The prevailing judgment is do not approve public alpha today because checkout-local success does not establish the release path, live-host behavior, independent review, or remote security controls.
The mainline assumes each listed missing check must be completed before any conditional approval can be issued, rather than made an enforceable pre-publication condition.
The single bound fixture provides no underlying reports, candidate identifier, execution dates, independent corroboration, or proof that a conditional release gate can be enforced.

The strongest contrary case is conditional approval with an enforceable no-publication gate: the positive local tests, build, hygiene scan, and governance documents justify preparing release mechanics while publication remains blocked until all missing checks pass.

The contrary case does not support public alpha today: no evidence establishes an enforceable gate, and the fixture explicitly leaves reproducible installation, candidate CI, authenticated execution, independent review, and remote security state unknown.

The checked evidence-quality and systems-trade-study results both recommend do not approve today and both report the same one-reference shortfall; no contradiction between their conclusions is present.
Retain the do-not-approve judgment for public alpha today; the challenge narrows the alternative to preparatory work behind a verified gate, not publication approval.
Standard Devil's Advocacy requires at least two evidence references, but exactly one is bound, so this challenge pass cannot claim complete standard-rigor evidence coverage.

alternatives: Conditionally approve preparation today under an enforceable no-publication gate that releases only after every missing check passes; this is the strongest alternative, but the gate and checks are not evidenced.

method_artifact.mainline_judgment: Do not approve public alpha today.
mainline_evidence: Positive evidence is limited to one existing macOS checkout.
Five release-relevant evidence categories are explicitly missing.
mainline_assumptions: Unknown release-path and security-control states cannot be treated as satisfied.
Conditional approval today would be unsafe unless its publication gate is enforceable.
method_artifact.challenge_target: The inference that missing pre-release evidence rules out even a conditional approval today.
evidence_weaknesses: All claims originate in one bound fixture without underlying records or dates.
No evidence establishes whether a release gate exists or is enforceable.
counterevidence: Local tests, package build, hygiene scan, and governance documents indicate meaningful preparatory readiness.
method_artifact.alternative_case: Permit release preparation under a hard no-publication gate, converting the missing evidence into explicit preconditions without exposing users today.
alternative_assumptions: The gate is technically and procedurally enforceable.
No publication can occur until every release-relevant check is evidenced.
surviving_mainline: Public alpha today remains unsupported because release-path execution, independent review, and remote controls are unknown.
Local success in an existing checkout cannot substitute for clean-clone or candidate-commit evidence.
material_challenges: The mainline should distinguish safe preparatory authorization from actual publication approval.
method_artifact.disposition: Retain do not approve public alpha today; preparatory work behind a verified gate is the only credible alternative.
change_conditions: A second independently bound record corroborates the candidate and its checks.
Clean-clone install and build, exact-candidate CI, authenticated live-host smoke execution, and independent security or correctness review complete without release blockers.
Remote visibility and repository security settings are read back as release-appropriate.
For conditional approval, an enforceable no-publication gate is demonstrated.
method_artifact.discriminating_evidence: Observed success for the exact candidate across the missing checks, plus proof of an enforceable publication gate, would discriminate conditional approval from do not approve.

confidence.basis: The explicit gaps make withholding publication robust, but the single evidence reference prevents complete standard-rigor challenge coverage.

change_conditions: Change to conditional approval when a second independent evidence reference is bound, all missing release checks pass for the exact candidate, remote controls are verified, and a no-publication gate is enforceable; change to approval when those conditions are satisfied without unresolved blockers.

errors.message: Standard Devil's Advocacy requires at least two evidence references, but only case is bound; no evidence was invented.
